event.title: Community infrastructure clinic: Diagnosing dependencies and designing digital self-determination in Brussels, Belgio

body.p: The session is designed as a hands-on, participatory experience where attendees become “digital infrastructure doctors”. It is aimed at a mixed audience, including community organisers, digital rights practitioners, designers and technologists, and does not require advanced technical knowledge. Working in small groups, participants explore fictional community scenarios, map the knowledge and digital practices that sustain them, diagnose hidden dependencies on proprietary infrastructures, and collaboratively design healthier alternatives. The workshop is based on collective problem-solving: participants bring their own experiences and perspectives, while the facilitator provides the framework, questions and tools to guide reflection. Through discussion, mapping exercises and collaborative “treatment plans”, attendees actively shape the outcomes rather than passively receiving information.
